impacted_node_details.name: Permission
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC schema node. Defines 8 base permissions (4 actions x 2 scopes). Unique constraint on (action, scope) per M1 correction. Supports Epic 1 Story 1.2.

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment
prd_reference.story_name: Define & Persist Core Permissions and Scopes

impacted_node_details.name: RolePermission
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC schema node. Maps roles to permissions. Unique constraint on (role_id, permission_id) per M1 correction. Supports Epic 1 Story 1.3.

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment
prd_reference.story_name: Define & Persist Default Roles and Mappings

impacted_node_details.name: UserRoleAssignment
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC schema node. Core assignment logic with scope inheritance. Unique constraint on (user_id, role_id, scope_type, scope_id) per M1. Composite index per L2. Supports Epic 1 Stories 1.4-1.6 and Epic 2 Stories 2.1-2.5.

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

impacted_node_details.name: RBACService
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC core service. Provides can_access() for authorization (<50ms p95), assign_role/remove_role for management (<200ms p95), and get_accessible_scope_ids() for optimized list filtering. Supports Epic 2 Stories 2.1-2.5.

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

impacted_node_details.name: GET /api/v1/rbac/roles
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. List all available roles (Admin, Owner, Editor, Viewer). Admin only. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.1.

impacted_node_details.name: GET /api/v1/rbac/assignments
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. List role assignments with optional filtering by user, role, scope_type, scope_id. Admin only. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.2.

impacted_node_details.name: POST /api/v1/rbac/assignments
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Create new role assignment. Admin only. Cannot assign to immutable scopes. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.3.

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

impacted_node_details.name: PATCH /api/v1/rbac/assignments/{id}
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Update role assignment (change role). Admin only. Cannot modify immutable assignments. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.4.

impacted_node_details.name: DELETE /api/v1/rbac/assignments/{id}
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Delete role assignment. Admin only. Cannot delete immutable assignments. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.5.

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

impacted_node_details.name: GET /api/v1/rbac/check-permission
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Check if current user has specific permission. Used by frontend usePermission hook. Supports Epic 2 Story 2.2.

impacted_node_details.name: RBACManagementPage
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC UI page. Main management interface for role assignments. Tabbed layout with assignments list and roles reference. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.1.

prd_reference.story_name: RBAC Management Section in the Admin Page

impacted_node_details.name: AssignmentListView
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC UI component. Displays role assignments in filterable table with edit/delete actions. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.2.

impacted_node_details.name: CreateAssignmentModal
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC UI component. Guided wizard for creating role assignments. 4-step workflow ensures valid assignments. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.3.

impacted_node_details.name: RBACGuard
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC UI component. Declarative route protection based on permissions. Renders children only if user has required permission. Supports Epic 2 Story 2.2. Addresses audit issue M4.

impacted_node_details.name: usePermission
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: New RBAC hook. Reusable permission check for UI rendering decisions (hide/disable/read-only). Uses check-permission API endpoint. Supports Epic 2 Story 2.2.

impacted_node_details.name: AdminPage
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: Add RBAC Management tab containing RBACManagementPage component. Update navigation to include /admin route with /rbac sub-route.

prd_reference.story_name: RBAC Management Section in the Admin Page

impacted_node_details.name: CollectionPage
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: Add permission-based filtering using usePermission hook. Hide create button if no CREATE permission. Hide delete button if no DELETE permission. Filter displayed flows/projects to only those with READ permission.

impacted_node_details.name: FlowPage
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: Add read-only mode support using usePermission hook. Disable editing controls if UPDATE permission not available. Show 'View Only' indicator. Allow execution with READ permission (C3).

impacted_node_details.name: User
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: Add role_assignments relationship to UserRoleAssignment. Maintain is_superuser flag for backward compatibility (H2).

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

impacted_node_details.name: Flow
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: No structural changes. Permission checks via UserRoleAssignment replace user_id filtering (C1).

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment
prd_reference.story_name: Define Project to Flow Role Extension Rule

impacted_node_details.name: Folder
impacted_node_details.impact_summary: No structural changes. Requires immutability check for User's Default Project (DEFAULT_FOLDER_NAME). Owner assignment must set is_immutable=True (C2, M6).

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment
prd_reference.story_name: Define Project to Flow Role Extension Rule

impacted_node_details.impact_summary: Add auto-assignment of Owner role to creator with rollback on failure (H5). Check CREATE permission on parent project (H3).

new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC schema node. Maps roles to permissions. Unique constraint on (role_id, permission_id) per M1 correction. Supports Epic 1 Story 1.3.

new_nodes.name: UserRoleAssignment

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC schema node. Core assignment logic with scope inheritance. Unique constraint on (user_id, role_id, scope_type, scope_id) per M1. Composite index per L2. Supports Epic 1 Stories 1.4-1.6 and Epic 2 Stories 2.1-2.5.

new_nodes.name: RBACService

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC core service. Provides can_access() for authorization (<50ms p95), assign_role/remove_role for management (<200ms p95), and get_accessible_scope_ids() for optimized list filtering. Supports Epic 2 Stories 2.1-2.5.

new_nodes.name: GET /api/v1/rbac/roles
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. List all available roles (Admin, Owner, Editor, Viewer). Admin only. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.1.

new_nodes.name: GET /api/v1/rbac/assignments
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. List role assignments with optional filtering by user, role, scope_type, scope_id. Admin only. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.2.

new_nodes.name: POST /api/v1/rbac/assignments

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Create new role assignment. Admin only. Cannot assign to immutable scopes. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.3.

new_nodes.name: PATCH /api/v1/rbac/assignments/{id}
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Update role assignment (change role). Admin only. Cannot modify immutable assignments. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.4.

new_nodes.name: DELETE /api/v1/rbac/assignments/{id}

prd_reference.epic_name: Core RBAC Data Model and Default Assignment

new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Delete role assignment. Admin only. Cannot delete immutable assignments. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.5.

new_nodes.name: GET /api/v1/rbac/check-permission
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC API endpoint. Check if current user has specific permission. Used by frontend usePermission hook. Supports Epic 2 Story 2.2.

new_nodes.name: RBACManagementPage

prd_reference.story_name: RBAC Management Section in the Admin Page

new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC UI page. Main management interface for role assignments. Tabbed layout with assignments list and roles reference. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.1.

new_nodes.name: AssignmentListView
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC UI component. Displays role assignments in filterable table with edit/delete actions. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.2.

new_nodes.name: CreateAssignmentModal
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC UI component. Guided wizard for creating role assignments. 4-step workflow ensures valid assignments. Supports Epic 3 Story 3.3.

new_nodes.name: RBACGuard
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC UI component. Declarative route protection based on permissions. Renders children only if user has required permission. Supports Epic 2 Story 2.2. Addresses audit issue M4.

new_nodes.name: usePermission
new_nodes.impact_summary: New RBAC hook. Reusable permission check for UI rendering decisions (hide/disable/read-only). Uses check-permission API endpoint. Supports Epic 2 Story 2.2.

modified_nodes.name: AdminPage

prd_reference.story_name: RBAC Management Section in the Admin Page

modified_nodes.impact_summary: Add RBAC Management tab containing RBACManagementPage component. Update navigation to include /admin route with /rbac sub-route.

modified_nodes.name: CollectionPage
modified_nodes.impact_summary: Add permission-based filtering using usePermission hook. Hide create button if no CREATE permission. Hide delete button if no DELETE permission. Filter displayed flows/projects to only those with READ permission.

modified_nodes.name: FlowPage
modified_nodes.impact_summary: Add read-only mode support using usePermission hook. Disable editing controls if UPDATE permission not available. Show 'View Only' indicator. Allow execution with READ permission (C3).
